Hi team,

Thanks for taking this on — Aurelia Health closed last week (deal ID RDW-DEAL-4391). Quick context and asks so CS/Eng can take ownership of the implementation and run the kickoff: 

- ARR / term: ~$240k ARR, 12-month term (Phase 1).
- Primary contacts: Samantha Lee (Head of Data Products) and Tom Nguyen (Procurement).
- Target go-live: 2027-07-28 (Aurelia has a launch window at month-end).
- High-level scope (Phase 1): chat & structured outputs for clinical routing, embeddings for search, SSO (SAML), and daily batch ingest of historical notes (3M docs).

Key constraints / risks:
- Procurement signed MSA but asked for SOC2 evidence and an extra audit clause — legal cleared but we should expect additional evidence requests.
- They require SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning before go-live.
- Token volume estimate: 80M tokens/month after ramp (see Ben's note below).

Attachments: Aurelia_Signed_Contract_20270622.pdf, SOW-Aurelia-Phase1-20270622.pdf, initial_runbook.xlsx (see Drive link in metadata).

Ask: please own the kickoff, confirm owners for the tasks below, and propose the 2-week runbook to get to a staging demo by 2027-07-12.

Owner suggestions:
- Marissa: CS lead / primary customer owner (onboarding & success metrics)
- Ben: Solutions/SE for ingest pipeline + model tuning
- Karthik: Implementation PM for scheduling / acceptance criteria

Kickoff options: Wed 2027-06-30 10:00-10:45 PT or Thu 2027-07-01 14:00-14:45 PT — I shared both times with Samantha.

Thanks — I'll stay on the thread for the kickoff.

—Dylan

1) Data ingestion: are the historical notes coming as daily batches (CSV/JSON) or via direct DB access? If S3, do we have sample layouts and expected file sizes?
2) SSO: do we have a named IdP contact or just the requirement? We need SAML metadata to validate in our staging environment.
3) Success metrics: their stated acceptance criteria in the SOW is "95% intent routing accuracy" — do we have an evaluation prompt set from the PO?

I'll take ownership of scheduling the pre-kickoff call for discovery and will draft a 14-day runbook once the ingestion path and SSO contact are confirmed.

Thanks — technical notes for the runbook and staging prep: 

- Model variant: we'll start with the "redwood-safety-std-7b" quantized variant for chat flows and evaluate latency/cost. If their accuracy needs it, we can test a 13b variant in staging.
- Expected load: ramp to ~3 rps average, burst to 20 rps; estimate ~80M tokens/month post-ramp.
- Ingest plan: S3 -> Kafka -> preprocessing lambda to normalize notes (expected ~2.3 TB compressed total). We'll need a 72-hour dry-run for the first historical ingest.
- Staging endpoints: I'll provision a staging cluster with the same kernel selection and a KV cache warmup. Staging demo target: 2027-07-12.
- SSO: once we get SAML metadata, provide test SP metadata endpoint and a test account.

Attachments: aurelia_test_plan.md (contains test cases for routing accuracy, load profile, and acceptance checklist).

I'll create the staging infra tickets and link them in the runbook folder.

—Ben
